name: Ember & Oat
headline: Slow coffee. Warm mornings.
sub: Specialty coffee, house-baked pastries and a sunny window seat on Brunswick Street.

features.d: A rotating bean from a small Victorian roaster, dialled in fresh each morning.
Croissants, banana bread and a savoury of the day, out of the oven by seven.
Coffee and pastry boxes for teams of ten to fifty, delivered across the inner north.

intent: Warm and slow, the opposite of a chain. A big serif headline, ember for actions, and steam that actually rises.
alt: Concept homepage for Ember & Oat, a fictional Fitzroy café, with a steaming coffee cup on an espresso-brown background

name: Northline Plumbing
headline: Burst pipe? We're already on the way.
sub: Licensed plumbers for blocked drains, hot water and gas across Melbourne's north. You get a fixed price before we start.

features.d: Camera inspection and jetting, so the blockage is gone, not just pushed further down.
Repairs and same-week replacements for gas, electric and heat-pump systems.
Leak checks, cooktops and heaters, with compliance paperwork handled for you.

intent: Calm under pressure. Deep navy reads as trustworthy, and one hot coral colour is saved for the button that matters: booking.
alt: Concept homepage for Northline Plumbing, a fictional Melbourne plumber, with coral ripples on a deep navy background

name: Saltbush Studio
headline: Hair that feels like you, only lighter.
sub: Colour, cuts and treatments in a calm, plant-filled studio on High Street. Book online in under a minute.

features.d: Balayage and soft blondes that grow out gently, so you're not back every five weeks.
A proper consult first, then a cut that works with your texture, not against it.
Calming treatments and take-home advice for dry, oily or colour-tired hair.

intent: Soft and editorial, like a magazine spread. Arched windows and leaves bring the plant-filled studio onto the screen.
alt: Concept homepage for Saltbush Studio, a fictional Northcote salon, with arched windows and leaves in sage and clay

name: Fernhollow Builders
headline: Renovations, built right the first time.
sub: Extensions, kitchens and full home renovations across Melbourne's east, with one fixed-price quote and a weekly update.

features.d: Second storeys and rear extensions, planned around how your family actually lives.
Full fit-outs with a fixed schedule, so you're not washing dishes in the laundry for months.
Photos and a plain-English progress note every Friday, whether you ask or not.

intent: Solid and engineered. Heavy type, a blueprint grid and an ochre line drawing say 'we plan before we build'.
alt: Concept homepage for Fernhollow Builders, a fictional Melbourne builder, with an ochre line drawing of a house on a blueprint grid
